approvalMessage.text:
APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 1  Chapter 197
 
      MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 8102-A, entitled:
 
    "AN  ACT to amend the general business law, in relation to requiring
        charging cords for micromobility devices, mopeds,  and  bicycles
        with electric assist to have a red tag attached"
 
    APPROVED
 
  This  bill  would  require  that  micromobility devices, bicycles with
electric assist, and limited use motorcycles be  sold  with  a  red  tag
affixed  to the charging cord that contains consumer safety information,
including a notification that the cord should be unplugged when  not  in
use.
 
  I strongly support the intent of this bill to enhance consumer safety.
These kinds of devices often rely on lithium-ion batteries that may pose
unique  fire hazards, and providing consumers with safety information at
their fingertips may help reduce such hazards. I have secured an  agree-
ment with the Legislature to make technical changes, including harmoniz-
ing certain definitions for consistency with other New York laws.  Based
upon this agreement, I am pleased to sign this bill into law.
 
  This bill is approved.                         (signed) KATHY HOCHUL
 
                                ______

summary: Requires micromobility devices, mopeds, and bicycles with electric assist to have a red tag attached to the charging cord which states to unplug when not in use.
